blocks.en: # Workflow and file map **English** · [简体中文](WORKFLOW.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## Workflow overview The receptor structure and ligand microstate are prepared separately. Choose the docking engine, molecular dynamics force field, and compute backend independently. Use the co-crystal benchmark to verify the docking installation and protocol. [Reference redocking](ENVIRONMENT.md#benchmark) ![Figure 1. Docking engine, pose handoff, and MD force field are independent choices.](../assets/workflow-map.png) *Figure 1. Docking engine, pose handoff, and MD force field are independent choices.*
blocks.zh: # 流程与文件地图 [English](WORKFLOW.md) · **简体中文** [仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) ## 完整流程图 从两条输入开始。receptor（受体）按所选链和结构状态准备，配体按所选化学状态准备。对接引擎、MD force field（力场）和 GROMACS 设备可以独立选择。首次使用先做[共晶重对接验收](ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md#benchmark)。 ![图 1. 对接引擎、docking pose（对接位姿）交接和 MD force field（力场）是独立决策。](../assets/workflow-map.zh-CN.png) *图 1. 对接引擎、docking pose（对接位姿）交接和 MD force field（力场）是独立决策。*

blocks.en:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    source["Source PDB and SDF"] --> prep["PyMOL · Molscrub · RDKit · Meeko"]
    prep --> vina["Vina · CPU"] & uni["Uni-Dock · CUDA"]
    vina & uni --> pose["Selected pose · Meeko or RDKit mapping"]
    pose --> audit["Verify chemistry and coordinates"]
    audit --> amber["AMBER · AmberTools · ACPYPE"] & charmm["CHARMM · CGenFF"]
    amber & charmm --> md["GROMACS · build, equilibrate, sample"]
    md --> fig["GROMACS · PLIP/ProLIF · PyMOL · Python"]
```
blocks.zh:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    source["原始 PDB 与 SDF"] --> prep["PyMOL · Molscrub · RDKit · Meeko"]
    prep --> vina["Vina · CPU"] & uni["Uni-Dock · CUDA"]
    vina & uni --> pose["选定对接位姿 · Meeko 或 RDKit 映射"]
    pose --> audit["核对化学身份与坐标"]
    audit --> amber["AMBER · AmberTools · ACPYPE"] & charmm["CHARMM · CGenFF"]
    amber & charmm --> md["GROMACS · 建系、平衡、采样"]
    md --> fig["GROMACS · PLIP/ProLIF · PyMOL · Python"]
```

blocks.en: [Diagnose the Chem3D and PyMOL conversion shortcut](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#chem3d-pymol-topology) ### Tools and file handoffs | Step | Tools and roles | Files or checks | | --- | --- | --- | | [01–02 Setup and validation](ENVIRONMENT.md#setup) | Miniforge/Conda manages environments. Use Linux on servers and WSL2 or native Vina on Windows. NVIDIA drivers and CUDA support the GPU tools. | 1IEP co-crystal redocking, logs, and heavy-atom RMSD. | | [03 Receptor preparation](DOCKING.md#docking) | Use RCSB PDB for source structures and open-source PyMOL to inspect chains, pockets, and the co-crystal ligand. Meeko prepares the docking receptor. AutoDockTools can assist with legacy inputs or GPF inspection. | Reviewed protein PDB, receptor PDBQT, box. | | [03 Ligand preparation](DOCKING.md#docking) | PubChem or another documented source provides the SDF. Molscrub generates protonation states, tautomers, and 3D candidates. RDKit checks graph, stereochemistry, and net charge. Meeko writes mapped PDBQT. | Source and selected-state SDFs, ligand PDBQT. | | [04 Docking and follow-up](DOCKING.md#docking) | AutoDock Vina uses CPU threads and Uni-Dock uses NVIDIA CUDA. Review poses and pocket contacts in a structure viewer. | Poses, logs, candidate IDs, box, and seeds. | | [05 Pose recovery and QC](DOCKING.md#pose-handoff) | A exports SDF from Meeko mappings. B maps a legacy ADT pose onto the original SDF with RDKit. Both require chemistry and coordinate checks before Open Babel converts to MOL2. | Selected pose SDF, MOL2, atom mapping, and absolute coordinate check. | | [06–07 Force fields and assembly](SYSTEM_SETUP.md#topology) | GROMACS `pdb2gmx` parameterizes the protein. For AMBER ligands, use AmberTools (`antechamber`, `sqm`, `parmchk2`, and `tleap`) and ACPYPE. The CHARMM ligand uses CGenFF and the Lemkul Lab converter. | AMBER99SB-ILDN + GAFF2/AM1-BCC or CHARMM36m + CGenFF, with matching coordinate and topology atom order. | | [08–10 Setup and production](SYSTEM_SETUP.md#simulation) | GROMACS handles boxing, solvation, ions, EM, NVT, NPT, unrestrained tests, production, and restarts. | MDP, TPR, CPT, EDR, XTC, and logs. | | [11–12 Analysis and figures](ANALYSIS.md#analysis) | GROMACS and MDAnalysis analyze trajectories. gmx_MMPBSA can estimate endpoint energies. Open-source PyMOL renders structures, pandas / Matplotlib / seaborn prepare plots, and Inkscape or optional GIMP / Photoshop assembles panels. | XVG, CSV, representative structures, structure PNGs, vector plots, and editable figures. | ## Printable run checklist - [ ] Record source structure, ligand microstate, package lock and hashes. - [ ] Save box geometry, backend, seed and docking output. - [ ] Verify chemical graph, stereochemistry, charge and mapped heavy-atom coordinates. - [ ] Match force-field family, water, ions and topology ordering. - [ ] Save checkpoints, verify the production input and document equilibration. - [ ] Validate trajectory and report analysis window, selections and replicates. Run `make skeleton RUN=runs/study01` in the repository root to create a new directory structure. Use `make check STEP=05 RUN=runs/1iep-dock` to invoke the stage-specific check. [Batch schema](../examples/README.md) · [Slurm template](../config/tutorial.sbatch)
blocks.zh: [查看两条路线的对比图](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#chem3d-pymol-topology) ### 工具与文件交接 | 步骤 | 工具与职责 | 关键文件或检查 | | --- | --- | --- | | [01–02 部署与验收](ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md#setup) | Miniforge/Conda 管理环境。Linux 为服务器方案，Windows 可用 WSL2 或原生 Vina。NVIDIA 驱动及 CUDA 支持 GPU 工具。 | 1IEP 共晶重对接、日志、heavy atom（重原子） RMSD。 | | [03 receptor（受体）准备](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#docking) | RCSB PDB 提供源结构。开源 PyMOL 审查链、口袋和共晶配体。Meeko 制备对接 receptor（受体），AutoDockTools 可辅助处理旧项目或查看 GPF。 | 审核后的蛋白 PDB、receptor（受体） PDBQT、搜索盒。 | | [03 配体准备](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#docking) | PubChem 等提供原始 SDF。Molscrub 生成质子化、互变异构和 3D 候选。RDKit 核对化学图、手性和净电荷，Meeko 输出带映射的 PDBQT。 | 原始 SDF、选定状态 SDF、配体 PDBQT。 | | [04 对接与复筛](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#docking) | AutoDock Vina 用 CPU 多线程，Uni-Dock 用 NVIDIA CUDA。用结构查看器检查 docking pose（对接位姿）和口袋接触。 | docking pose（对接位姿）、日志、候选 ID、搜索盒和种子。 | | [05 恢复与质检](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#pose-handoff) | A 用 Meeko 映射导出 SDF。B 用原始 SDF 和经审核的 atom mapping（原子映射），由 RDKit 恢复旧 ADT docking pose（对接位姿）。两条路线都通过化学与坐标检查，再用 Open Babel 转 MOL2。 | 入选 docking pose（对接位姿）的 SDF、MOL2、atom mapping（原子映射）及绝对坐标核对。 | | [06–07 两套 force field（力场）与组装](SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#topology) | 蛋白由 GROMACS `pdb2gmx` 参数化。AMBER 配体采用 AmberTools（`antechamber`、`sqm`、`parmchk2`、`tleap`）与 ACPYPE；CHARMM 配体采用 CGenFF 与 Lemkul Lab 转换器。 | AMBER99SB-ILDN + GAFF2/AM1-BCC 或 CHARMM36m + CGenFF，坐标和 topology（拓扑）原子顺序一致。 | | [08–10 建系与生产](SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#simulation) | GROMACS 完成建盒、加水加盐、EM、NVT、NPT、解除位置限制后试跑、生产和检查点续跑。 | MDP、TPR、CPT、EDR、XTC 与日志。 | | [11–12 分析与出图](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#analysis) | GROMACS / MDAnalysis 处理轨迹，gmx_MMPBSA 可做端点能量估算。开源 PyMOL 出结构图，pandas / Matplotlib / seaborn 出曲线与统计图，Inkscape 或可选的 GIMP / Photoshop 组图。 | XVG、CSV、代表结构、结构图 PNG、矢量曲线图和可编辑图版。 | ## 可打印运行核查清单 - [ ] 记录结构来源、配体微观状态、环境锁文件与哈希。 - [ ] 保存盒几何、对接引擎、种子和输出。 - [ ] 核对化学图、立体化学、电荷与已映射的重原子坐标。 - [ ] 核对 force field（力场）家族、水、离子及 topology（拓扑）顺序。 - [ ] 保存检查点，校验生产输入并记录平衡。 - [ ] 核验轨迹，报告分析窗口、原子选择与重复。 在仓库根目录执行 `make skeleton RUN=runs/study01` 创建新的目录骨架；用 `make check STEP=05 RUN=runs/1iep-dock` 调用对应阶段核验。[批处理结构](../examples/README.md) · [Slurm 模板](../config/tutorial.sbatch)
